notes.title: Next Fest Live: Community Plays
notes.content:
Event Date & Time 
Thursday, June 13 @ 7:00 PM Eastern Time
Duration: 1 hour

Community + Dev Collab
Watch streamer SoEverdream try out the HANGRY™ Demo, joined in the chat by Travis - a designer for the game. While the broadcaster engages the audience and gives his thoughts on the game, Travis will be happy to discuss the game's mechanics and answer questions from the chat, or from SoEverdream himself!

Join Us
You can join the conversation directly on the Steam Broadcast page, or on SoEverdream's Twitch channel. 
We hope to see you there!

Try the Game
The HANGRY™ Demo is available now on the main store page, and will remain available until the end of Steam Next Fest on June 17th.

Don't miss this opportunity to try the game and give us your feedback!
